item: A file where the safety copy's folder should be is refused on Windows too; four Windows test assumptions corrected
summary: Product: take_verified_backup refused a file where the backup folder should be only on POSIX, where lstat raises NotADirectoryError; Windows answers path not found, which read as absent, and the copy then failed in mkdir with a raw FileExistsError. The nearest existing part of the folder must now be a folder, refused by class with the same words on both. Tests that assumed POSIX: SIGHUP is absent on Windows (checked only where it exists); write_text writes CRLF on Windows (the fingerprint test writes bytes); Windows keeps only a read-only bit, so 0o644 reads back as an ordinary file's 0o666 (compared to one); the JSON parser's depth limit is lower on Windows, so the deep-store tests use the deepest of a few depths this platform parses, still deeper than the recursion limit.
